correctness.rationale: Deleting the last coordinate embeds a radius-\(s\) Hamming ball about each length-\(n-1\) prefix into the channel ball. Disjoint channel balls force prefix distance at least \(2s+1\). This forbids two codewords for \(n\le2s+1\); at \(n=2s+2\) it makes first symbols pairwise distinct, so at most \(q\) codewords occur. Constant words attain \(q\). The finite verifier independently reconstructs channel balls for small parameters and agrees with every boundary assertion.
